summary_1line: Samva defeats Salwa’s commanders while Pradyumna rallies the Yadavas and duels Salwa, briefly felling him before the battle turns again.

image_candidates.scene_text: Samva whirls a heavy mace and hurls it into the charging Daitya Vegavat, who crashes to the ground like a shattered forest tree.
Pradyumna stands on a golden chariot with a Makara-banner streaming above him as arrows flash from his bow faster than the eye can follow.
Pradyumna’s blazing arrow pierces Salwa’s armor and the king collapses senseless on his chariot while the Danava army recoils in shock.
